MAINICHI, October 20, 1939.

CANADIAN FEMALE SPY IN LOVE WITH AMBASSADOR OF
A CERTAIN PRO-CHIANG COUNTRY

On July 9, a beautiful Canadian girl left
Shanghai for America aboard the Empress of Japan. She
occupied cabin No.3C3. A few days after the ship had
left Yokohama, the following facts were ascertained:-
The girl's name is "Jean Ewen", age 28,
of Canadian nationality. She is the girl upon whom
has been lavished the whole-hearted love of an Ambassador
of a certain pro-Chiang Kai-shek country.
On the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese
hostilities, she smuggled herself into Shanghai from
Peking and joined the 8th Route Army and worked as an
international spy by taking advantage of her work as a
nurse.
She reported to the Japanese authorities
that the object of her travels was to purchase drugs and
medical appliances; but actually she was planning to
purchase a large quantity of arms in America for dispatch
to Chungking via Rangoon.
In Shanghai, she stayed at the Communist
Party Club in Young Terrace, Weihaiwei Road. While
working as a spy, she continued her meetings with the
Ambassador so much so that there was some talk of a
divorce between the Ambassador and his wife.
The girl's father is a leading communist
in Canada. She became a nurse after leaving school.
She came to China alone at the age of 22.
She once served as secretary to Lieutenant-Colonel Spear,
Chief of the British Special Service, who was recently
held by the Japanese authorities at Kalgan.
It would be no exaggeration to say that
she, with her beauty and intelligence, must have played
many important roles in Shanghai.

《每日新闻》，1939年10月20日。

某亲蒋国家大使恋上加拿大女间谍

7月9日，一位美丽的加拿大姑娘乘坐“日本皇后号”轮船离开上海前往美国。她占据的是3C3号客舱。船离横滨数日后，查明了以下事实：该女子名为“Jean Ewen”，28岁，加拿大国籍。她是一位某亲蒋介石国家的大使全心爱慕的对象。
中日战事爆发后，她从北平偷渡至上海，加入八路军，并利用其护士工作之便从事国际间谍活动。
她向日本当局报告称，其旅行目的是购买药品和医疗器械；但实际上，她正计划在美国购买大量军火，经仰光运往重庆。
在上海期间，她住在威海卫路扬子公寓的共产党俱乐部。在从事间谍工作的同时，她继续与这位大使会面，以至于外界有传言称该大使与其妻子即将离婚。
该女子的父亲是加拿大的一名共产党要员。她毕业后成为了一名护士。22岁时，她独自来到中国。她曾担任英国特别服务处（British Special Service）处长斯皮尔（Spear）中校的秘书，斯皮尔中校最近被日本当局拘押于张家口。
毫不夸张地说，凭借她的美貌和智慧，她在上海一定扮演过许多重要角色。

SHANGHAI TIMES.

DEC 1 _ 1939

DETAILS REGARDING
DR. BETHUNE
Canadian Physician Had
Served In Communist
Army In Shensi

CHUNGKING, Nov. 30.—Further
details regarding Dr. Bethune,
Canadian physician who is report-
ed to have died on November 13
while serving with the Chinese
Communist Army in Shensi were
revealed here to-day.
Dr. Bethune was last seen by
friends in Hankow late in Febru-
ary last year, while completing
arrangements for a trip to North
Shansi.
Shortly afterwards, he travelled
northwards accompanied by a
Canadian nurse, Miss Jane Ewan.
The doctor carried with him
US$2,000 for establishing a field
hospital in North China.
Together with Dr. Charles Par-
sons, Associate Surgeon of the
Benediction Hospital at Kingston,
New York, he formed the first
medical unit to be financed by a
group of people in New York.
Dr. Parsons is now reported to
be working with the new Fourth
Army somewhere in the vicinity of
the Nanking-Shanghai area. —
Reuter.

1939年12月1日

关于白求恩博士的详细情况
加拿大医生曾在陕西共产党军队中服役

重庆，11月30日电——今日在此披露了关于加拿大医生白求恩博士的更多详情，据报道，他于11月13日在陕西为中国共产党军队服务期间去世。
朋友们最后一次见到白求恩博士是在去年2月下旬的汉口，当时他正在完成前往晋北的行程安排。
不久之后，他在一名加拿大护士简·尤恩（Jane Ewan）小姐的陪同下北上。
白求恩博士随身携带了2,000美元，用于在华北建立一所野战医院。
他与纽约金斯顿本尼迪克申医院（Benediction Hospital）的副外科医生查尔斯·帕森斯（Charles Parsons）博士一起，组建了由纽约一群人资助的第一个医疗队。
据报道，帕森斯博士目前正在南京-上海地区附近的某地与新四军一起工作。——路透社。
